sections.lead: ## 8\. Career Opportunities After Aerospace-Related Engineering Studies

items: A related engineering bachelor’s degree can build foundational skills for further training or specialised study in aerospace-related fields. Potential career directions, depending on additional qualifications and employer requirements, include:

Specialist aerospace positions may require additional education, specific technical experience or further qualifications. A general mechanical engineering bachelor’s degree does not automatically qualify a graduate for every aerospace engineering role.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide supports students throughout their study abroad journey, helping them make informed decisions about their academic future.
### 1\. Can I study Aerospace Engineering in Finland after Class 12?

A dedicated English-taught Bachelor’s in Aerospace Engineering was not identified in the official programme listings reviewed. Students can explore related bachelor’s programmes in Mechanical Engineering and other engineering fields.
### 2\. Which universities should I consider for aerospace-related engineering?

LUT University offers relevant bachelor-level programmes in Mechanical Engineering and Technology and Engineering Science. Aalto University also offers a bachelor-level study option in Mechanical and Civil Engineering. These are related engineering programmes, not dedicated aerospace degrees.
### 3\. What is the tuition fee for related engineering courses in Finland?

LUT University lists an annual tuition fee of €12,000 (approximately ₹13,03,200) for its English-taught Mechanical Engineering bachelor’s programme. Fees at other universities depend on the specific study option and intake.
### 4\. Which subjects should I study in Class 12?
Mathematics and Physics are especially useful for engineering studies. The exact subject requirements depend on the university and programme.
### 5\. Can I work in the aerospace industry after a Mechanical Engineering bachelor’s degree?

A Mechanical Engineering degree can provide relevant foundational knowledge, but aerospace-specific jobs may require specialised skills, additional qualifications or further study. Check individual job requirements and the curriculum of your chosen programme.
